verdict.rationale: Otter documents several in-product AI insight and suggestion features. Otter AI Chat answers questions across your meetings and connected apps, and summaries extract decisions, action items and insights, customizable by role. It also offers real-time coaching prompts drawn from your conversation history, sentiment and keyword monitoring across teams, and pre-meeting briefing documents. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality (all evidence is vendor-claimed, and one community report called a generated outline inaccurate).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions and help you create follow-ups, reports, and content.
Otter turns every meeting into a clear summary with decisions, action items, and insights.
Get real-time, personalized coaching and prompts during calls based on your entire conversation history, company playbooks, and what's being discussed.
Otter's fully customizable, AI-powered meeting summaries automatically extract actionable insights based on meeting purpose and for different functional roles
Monitor sentiment, engagement, and strategic keywords across customer-facing teams to align messaging and positioning.
